z-m-21-01.title: Ƙarshe ‘guda ɗaya’: da gaske guda ɗaya ne kawai?
z-m-21-01.topic: Rubuta furucin daraja 4 a matsayin ninkar furuci murabba'i biyu: bincika kowane hali mai yiwuwa
z-m-21-01.goal: Ka bincika ƙarshe ‘guda ɗaya’ da aka zartar bayan duba wasu daga cikin lokuta masu yiwuwa kawai. Ka ƙirƙiri ninkar furuci murabba'i daban-daban don furucin daraja 4 iri ɗaya domin tabbatarwa, sannan ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa yawan hanyoyin ya kayyadu ko da an faɗaɗa sharuɗɗa.
z-m-21-01.material: Jiho ya nemo hanyar rubuta x⁴−5x²+4 a fasalin (x²+ax+b)(x²+cx+d). Ma'aunin x² a cikin kowane furuci murabba'i biyu shi ne 1, a, b, c, d lambobi cikakku ne, kuma musanya jerin furucin murabba'i biyun (misali, musanya a, b da c, d) ana ɗauka a matsayin ninkar daidai. Bayan ya kammala warwarewar, Jiho ya ce, ‘Akwai ninkar irin wannan guda ɗaya kawai.’ Ga warwarewar Jiho a ƙasa. (Karatu: x⁴ ‘x a ƙarfin huɗu’, x² ‘x a murabba'i’, ac kuma ‘a ninka da c’.)
z-m-21-01.thinking.0: Nemo layin da aka bar wani hali a baya
z-m-21-01.thinking.1: Ƙirƙirar misalai daban-daban da kanka da ke karyata ƙarshe
z-m-21-01.thinking.2: Yanke shawarar yadda ƙarshe ke canzawa idan an canza sharaɗi (lambobi cikakku zuwa lambobi na ainihi)
z-m-21-01.prereq.0: Buɗe ninkar furucin murabba'i biyu da tsara sharuɗɗan daraja iri ɗaya (matakin darasin furucin aljebra na gama-gari: aji na 3 na sakandare zuwa aji na 1 na babbar sakandare)
z-m-21-01.prereq.1: Ma'anar furucin aljebra biyu da suke furuci ɗaya cikin x (daidaito). Rarraba matakin wannan aiki bisa wahala ne kawai a cikin rukunin samarwa, ba rarrabawar aji a manhaja ba
z-m-21-01.prereq.2: Kwarewar buɗe ninkar furucin layi kamar (x−1), (x+1)
z-m-21-01.s.s1.prompt: Wane layi ne ya sa ƙarshe Jiho na ‘guda ɗaya’ ya yi wuya a yarda da shi yadda yake? Zaɓi layi guda.
z-m-21-01.s.s1.hint.0: Ka yi alama ko kowane layi yana biyo kai tsaye daga layin da ya gabata, sannan ka gano layin da jimlar ‘wannan shi kaɗai ne’ ta fara bayyana.
z-m-21-01.s.s1.hint.1: Ga layin da ya yi jerin da ‘yana ɗaya daga cikin ...’ kamar layi na 4, ka sake ƙirƙirar jerin da kanka bisa sharaɗi iri ɗaya, sannan ka kwatanta shi ɗaya bayan ɗaya da jerin da aka rubuta a layin.
z-m-21-01.s.s1.line.0: Ka buɗe (x²+ax+b)(x²+cx+d), sannan ka daidaita ma'aunin kowace daraja domin ya zama furuci ɗaya da x⁴−5x²+4.
z-m-21-01.s.s1.line.1: Daga ma'aunin x³, a+c=0, saboda haka c=−a; daga ma'aunin x, ad+bc=a(d−b)=0, don haka a=0 ko b=d.
z-m-21-01.s.s1.line.3: b da d lambobi cikakku ne, kuma ninkarsu 4 ce, saboda haka (b, d) ɗaya ne daga (1, 4), (4, 1), (2, 2).
z-m-21-01.s.s1.line.4: Daga cikin waɗannan, guda ɗaya da ya cika ma'aunin x² b+d−a²=−5 shi ne b=d=2, a=3 (ko a=−3).
z-m-21-01.s.s1.line.5: Saboda haka (x²+3x+2)(x²−3x+2) ita ce ninkar irin wannan guda ɗaya.
z-m-21-01.s.s1.explain: Lissafin layuka na 1 zuwa 3 daidai ne (ma'aunin x² shi ne b+d+ac, kuma tun da c=−a, ya zama b+d−a²). Kuskure ya fara ne a layi na 4. Ma'auratan lambobi cikakku masu ninkar 4 sun haɗa da (−1, −4), (−4, −1), (−2, −2) ma, amma an rubuta ma'aurata tabbatattu kawai. Layi na 5 daidai ne ‘cikin jerin da aka rubuta’, amma jerin bai cika ba, don haka ‘guda ɗaya kawai’ a layi na 6 ba shi da hujja. Ko ka zaɓi layi na 6, matsalar ba lissafin layin kanta ba ce, sai dai ‘ko an bincika dukkan lokuta tun farko’.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.prompt: Ka ƙirƙiri ninkar furuci murabba'i biyu daban-daban (x²+ax+b)(x²+cx+d) da suka yi daidai da x⁴−5x²+4. (a, b, c, d lambobi cikakku ne. Waɗanda suka bambanta ta jujjuya jeri kawai ana ɗauka ninkar ɗaya ce.)
z-m-21-01.s.s2.hint.0: Ka sake gina jerin ƙimomin b, d da ke warwarewar Jiho da kanka, sannan ka saka ma'auratan da ba sa cikin jerin cikin sauran sharuɗɗan ma'aunai don dubawa.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.hint.1: Ka raba zuwa yanayi biyu: a=0 da b=d, sannan ka nemo ƙimomin b da d a kowanne.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.var.a: a (ma'aunin x na furuci na farko)
z-m-21-01.s.s2.var.b: b (adadin tsayayye na furuci na farko)
z-m-21-01.s.s2.var.c: c (ma'aunin x na furuci na biyu)
z-m-21-01.s.s2.var.d: d (adadin tsayayye na furuci na biyu)
z-m-21-01.s.s2.ok.c0: a, b, c, d duk lambobi cikakku ne.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.fail.c0: Ka ɗauki a, b, c, d a matsayin lambobi cikakku.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Ma'aunin x³ (a+c) bayan buɗewa ba 0 ba ne.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Ma'aunin x² (b+d+ac) bayan buɗewa ba −5 ba ne.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Ma'aunin x (ad+bc) bayan buɗewa ba 0 ba ne.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.fail.c4: Adadin tsayayye (bd) bayan buɗewa ba 4 ba ne.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.explain: Akwai ninkar lambobi cikakku guda uku masu yiwuwa: (x²−1)(x²−4), (x²+3x+2)(x²−3x+2), da (x²+x−2)(x²−x−2). Ninkar Jiho ɗaya ce daga cikinsu. Waɗanda suka bambanta ta jeri kawai, kamar musanya a da −a, an ƙirga su ninkar ɗaya.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.prompt: Idan ninkar furuci biyu daban-daban duk ta ba da x⁴−5x²+4, a ina ƙarshe Jiho na ‘guda ɗaya kawai’ ya yi kuskure? Ka rubuta jimloli biyu ko uku, ta amfani da aƙalla ɗaya daga furucin da ka ƙirƙira yanzu.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.hint.0: Ka buɗe kowace ninkar biyun da ka ƙirƙira, sannan ka kwatanta ko sakamakon furuci ɗaya ne.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.hint.1: Ka kwatanta yadda Jiho ya tsara lokuta masu yiwuwa da ko ninkar da ka ƙirƙira tana cikin jerinsa.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ka bincika da kanka ko furucin da ka bayar yana zama x⁴−5x²+4 da gaske idan aka buɗe shi kuwa?
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ka nuna cewa dalilin kuskuren shi ne ‘barin wasu lokuta masu yiwuwa’, ba ‘kuskuren lissafi’ ba kuwa?
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Ka kuma rubuta abin da dole ne a yi domin a ce ‘guda ɗaya kawai’ kuwa?
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.model.0: Buɗe (x²−1)(x²−4) yana ba da x⁴−5x²+4, kuma buɗe (x²+3x+2)(x²−3x+2) ma yana ba da furuci iri ɗaya. Ninkar biyun daidai ne, don haka ba guda ɗaya kawai ba ne. Jiho ya bar ma'auratan lambobi marasa kyau cikin ma'auratan lambobi cikakku masu ninkar 4, saboda haka guda ɗaya ne kawai ya rage.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.modelNote.0: Ya ambaci misalin ƙaryatawa (wata ninkar) da kuma dalili (barin wasu lokuta).
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.model.1: Ana iya rubuta x⁴−5x²+4 a matsayin (x−1)(x+1)(x−2)(x+2), don haka bisa yadda aka haɗa furucin layi huɗun zuwa ma'aurata, ana samun ninkar furucin murabba'i da dama, kamar (x²+x−2)(x²−x−2). Ƙarshe Jiho ya samo ne saboda ya nemo hanya guda kawai ba tare da bincika dukkan lokuta ba.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Bayani daga wata mahanga, haɗa furucin layi
z-m-21-01.s.s3.prompt: Yanzu mu faɗaɗa sharaɗin ‘ma'aunai lambobi cikakku ne’ zuwa ‘ma'aunai lambobi na ainihi ne’ (furuci murabba'i biyu masu ma'aunin x² daidai 1; waɗanda suka bambanta ta jeri kawai ninkar ɗaya ce). Za a iya amfani da sharuɗɗan ma'aunai na sama, a+c=0, a(d−b)=0, b+d−a²=−5, bd=4, yadda suke. Wace magana ce ta fi dacewa game da yawan ninkar da za su yiwu a wannan yanayin?
z-m-21-01.s.s3.hint.0: Fara da a(d−b)=0, raba zuwa yanayin a=0 da b=d, sannan ka rubuta ma'aunai da suka rage a kowanne.
z-m-21-01.s.s3.hint.1: A kowane reshe, warware kai tsaye sannan ka ƙirga ƙimomin da b da d za su iya ɗauka idan lambobin ainihi ne.
z-m-21-01.s.s3.o.a: Lambobin ainihi sun fi lambobi cikakku yawa sosai, saboda haka akwai rarrabawa marasa iyaka.
z-m-21-01.s.s3.r.a: Wannan tunani ya lura cewa idan an faɗaɗa lambobin da aka yarda, amsoshi ma suna ƙaruwa. Amma a nan, me zai hana mu fara duba yadda sharuddan coefficients suke danganta a, b, c, d da juna?
z-m-21-01.s.s3.o.b: Har yanzu uku ne. A rassan biyu (idan a=0 ko b=d), an riga an ƙayyade ƙimomin.
z-m-21-01.s.s3.r.b: Wannan hukunci ya raba zuwa rassan biyu sannan ya duba ko ƙimomin sun ƙayyade ko da a cikin lambobin ainihi.
z-m-21-01.s.s3.o.c: Ya ragu idan aka kwatanta da lambobi cikakku. Lambobin ainihi sun haɗa da lambobi cikakku, don haka sharadin ya fi tsauri.
z-m-21-01.s.s3.r.c: Ka yanke akasin hukunci daga gaskiyar cewa 'lambobin ainihi sun haɗa da lambobi cikakku.' Idan zangon da aka yarda ya faɗaɗa, rarrabawa masu yiwuwa ba za su ragu ba. Duba ko misalai uku na lambobi cikakku har yanzu suna aiki.
z-m-21-01.s.s3.o.d: Sharuddan ba su isa ba, saboda haka ba za mu iya faɗin adadinsu ba.
z-m-21-01.s.s3.r.d: Wannan hukunci ya ce 'babu isasshen bayani' ba tare da ƙirga ko daidaitattun hujjoji huɗun sun isa ba. Duba ko lissafin da ba a sani ba huɗu da ma'aunai huɗu sun ƙayyade ƙimomin.
z-m-21-01.s.s3.explain: Tunda a(d−b)=0, a=0 ko b=d. Idan a=0, to b+d=−5 da bd=4, saboda haka b su ne tushen −1 da −4 na t²+5t+4=0. Idan b=d, to b²=4, saboda haka b=±2, kuma a²=2b+5; idan b=2, a=±3, idan b=−2, a=±1. Ko a lambobin ainihi babu abin da ya wuce waɗannan rassan, saboda haka idan ba a la'akari da jerin ba har yanzu uku ne. Kasancewar lambobi cikakku ba ta tace mafita a wannan yanayin ba.
